Welcome to

FineLine

Circuit Company

Fineline Circuit Company (FCC), established in 2001, is a 100% Export Oriented Unit (EOU) specializing in high-quality Printed Circuit Board (PCB) manufacturing. With a state-of-the-art 60,000 sq. ft. facility near Baroda, Gujarat, FCC has a production capacity of 5,000 sq. meters per month for Single, Double, and Multi-Layer PCBs. Its North American operations are represented by FCC Electronics in Elk Grove Village, Illinois. Committed to innovation, quality, and timely delivery, FCC’s skilled workforce continuously upgrades its expertise to keep pace with evolving technologies, ensuring precision, efficiency, and customer satisfaction.
